design: Reset after 16 samples vs keep same target and continue to drop or timeout. Continue and dwell have the same one-off +3 at the first 16-sample run; dwell additionally pays 0.05*min(streak/61,1) per valid in-band sample. All start from matched parent actor, critic, normalization, optimizer and epoch. Compare final checkpoint only.
primary: entire final 61 samples in tolerance with no drop
secondary: fraction of all 600 samples alive and inside
promotion: Compared with BOTH reset control and frozen parent: higher final-61 rate on both engines, positive paired final-61 difference for at least two of three training seeds on each, aggregate entry no more than 5 pp lower and drop no more than 5 pp higher on each. Rank eligible configurations by worse-backend final-61 rate. This is an exploratory stage, not a hardware release.
